title.from: Alexa M4: Signed-in newsroom (personal feed and voice Accept/Reject)
title.to: Alexa M4: Review references by voice (MVP)

description.from:
Milestone 4. With a linked account, the skill becomes Ryan's newsroom on the kitchen counter.

Scope (YAGNI; extend later):
- "What's new for me": the person's ranked reference feed (the Apple-News-style feed), on screen and by voice.
- Accept / Reject by voice or by touch on a reference. Votes go through the same server write path as the web newsroom, so they train the site's Cyclotron under the learning-loop standard (PPY-c6aced). One Accept/Reject vocabulary.
- Authorization is enforced on the server for every write. The skill never holds more privilege than the user.
- Proposed Story review by voice is explicitly out of scope for this milestone. It can become a follow-up.

Done when: Ryan opens his feed on the Show, accepts and rejects references by voice and touch, and the votes appear in the newsroom and in the Cyclotron training data. Gherkin specs cover each.

Feature: Steer my feed by voice
  Scenario: Accept a reference
    Given I have linked my account
    And my feed is on screen
    When I say "accept this one"
    Then the vote is recorded as mine
    And the site's Cyclotron receives it as training data
description.to:
Milestone 4, rescoped by Ryan on 2026-10-31: **review References by voice**. This is the MVP for the whole initiative.

The editor reviews newsroom References one at a time. For each one Alexa says, and the Echo Show shows, the title, subtitle (deck) and summary. The editor says accept or reject, optionally with a reason ("reject, it's a press release"). The vote is recorded exactly as the web newsroom records it, so it trains the site's Cyclotron. Then the skill moves to the next reference.

**Two queues, chosen by voice:**
- **Most interesting** ("best bets", "what's good"): unrated References ordered by the Cyclotron's P(accept), highest first. This is the same order as `compareBestBets` in `lib/reference-feed-ranking.ts`, read from `Reference.predictedAcceptProbability` or the `relevance_decision_is` relation.
- **Needs my help** ("what needs me", "where are you unsure"): unrated References where the Cyclotron asked for review (`reviewRecommended`) come first, then those in order of uncertainty `1 - |2P - 1|`. This is the same rule as `lib/needs-me-ranking.ts`.

**Decided by Ryan (2026-10-31): votes go out under the editor's own sign-in.** The Alexa Lambda calls AppSync with the linked user's Cognito access token, as the web newsroom does from the browser. AppSync enforces the editor/admin groups and records `curationActorKind: human`, so the vote trains. This is a narrow, documented exception to "deployed Lambdas call AppSync with IAM only" (docs/agent-rules-detail.md): the skill only ever relays the end user's own token and never uses credentials of its own for a write. An IAM vote would be recorded as `agent` and would never train.

**Data paths, from the research on develop @ a2fe64f9:**
- Queue: `listReferencesByFeedStateAndPrediction(feedStateKey "<corpusId>#unrated", DESC)` once feed keys are backfilled; otherwise the newsroom's own `listReferencesByNewsroomFeedAndImportedAt` plus decision relations, ranked in the Lambda.
- Text: `referenceDisplayTitle`; the dek from the preview attachment (`lib/reference-preview.ts` `referenceDek`); the summary from the metadata ModelAttachment (`lib/reference-display.ts`), falling back to the curation card's `summary.text`.
- Vote: `reviewReferenceCuration(referenceId, action accept|reject, note, reasonCode, decisionRelationId, shareable)`. A reject needs a reason: `rejectionReasonCodeForWrittenReason` maps the spoken note, with `other` as the fallback. Only `out_of_scope`/`policy_exclusion` rejects become negative labels, so the skill asks for a reason in words.

**Account linking happens here.** A review request from an unlinked user gets a LinkAccount response, which shows the QR on an Echo Show. A linked user who is not an editor or admin hears that review is for editors.

Done when: Ryan, on his Echo Show, says "Alexa, ask Pilobolus newsroom what needs my help", links once with the QR, then accepts and rejects references one by one with reasons. The votes appear in the newsroom as his, recorded as human, and reach the Cyclotron sweep. Gherkin specs cover every turn against fakes.

Feature: Review references by voice
  Scenario: Accept the most interesting reference
    Given I have linked my editor account
    When I say "review the best bets"
    Then Alexa reads the title, subtitle and summary of the top reference
    When I say "accept"
    Then the reference is accepted under my name as a human vote
    And Alexa reads the next reference
  Scenario: Reject with a reason
    Given Alexa is reading a reference from the needs-my-help queue
    When I say "reject, it's off topic"
    Then the reference is rejected with that note and the out_of_scope reason code
  Scenario: Not linked yet
    Given I have not linked my account
    When I ask to review references
    Then Alexa asks me to link and my Echo Show shows the QR code
